subject: CAIQ: runtime evidence portal access & credentialing
messages:
From: Emma White <emma.white@fjordbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-team@fjordbank.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: runtime evidence portal access & credentialing

Hi Jonas and team,

Thanks again for the CAIQ delivery last week. The audit squad at FjordBank is preparing a targeted review focused on runtime artifacts (KV cache behavior, request/response sampling, and retention traces). Before we pull a formal evidence package, they prefer to inspect live samples via a read-only portal and a short-term service account so they can validate logs and sampling heuristics in situ.

Can Redwood provide:
- A temporary read-only portal account scoped to the CAIQ runtime sample area
- A list of the specific files and log prefixes the auditor will have visibility to
- Any constraints on time windows / IP allow-listing we need to coordinate

Timeline: they want access next week (window: Oct 12–15). If we can get onboarding steps and the account by EOB Oct 11 that would be ideal.

Let me know if we need an NDA or a separate access agreement for this view-only credential.

Cheers,
Emma
Emma White
Senior InfoSec Auditor, FjordBank
security-team@fjordbank.com

---
Attachment: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma White <emma.white@fjordbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: runtime evidence portal access & credentialing

Hi Emma — thanks for outlining the request. We can absolutely arrange a read-only, time-limited credential scoped to "CAIQ/runtime-samples" that exposes the runtime traces and sampled request logs. High-level plan below:

1) Portal user: create OIDC-linked user with read-only role, valid 48 hours (can be extended).
2) Scope: folder bucket redwood://evidence/CAIQ/FjordBank/runtime/ (read-only), plus pre-signed links for any archived sample bundles.
3) IP gating: optional — we can restrict by CIDR if you provide the auditor IPs.
4) Evidence list: we will provide a manifest (sample_log_extract-2026-09.tar.gz) with representative filepath examples and retention timestamps.

I attached onboarding instructions and the sample manifest for your review. Action items for us (internal): we need to confirm which runtime owners to notify for the sampling window and prepare an audit trail for the access event.

Can Kimberly and Naomi coordinate the ops changes and confirm we can stand up the portal account by EOB Oct 11? Emma — do you want the credential to be OIDC (auditor flows to their SSO) or a short-lived username/password?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood_portal_onboarding_instructions.pdf, sample_log_extract-2026-09.tar.gz

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: runtime evidence portal access & credentialing

Jonas — I'll take point on the provisioning and ops checklist. Quick notes:
- I will open a temporary service account in the portal (read-only role) and pin it to the evidence bucket Jonas referenced.
- For audit trail, we'll enable session logging and route session events to the existing evidence-shipping pipeline (retention policy: 90 days).
- Naomi, can you prepare the manifest with specific file paths and a short rationale for each artifact? I want the auditor to have 8–10 representative traces rather than a full dump.

Emma — for convenience most customers prefer a short-lived username + one-time password (we rotate after first use). If FjordBank requires OIDC/SAML, we can set up an IdP link but onboarding takes longer (we can run OIDC if you can onboard the auditor's SSO by Oct 14).

I'll target provisioning by 2026-10-11 18:00 PT and will post the portal link + ephemeral creds to the secure Drive link (see below). If the auditor needs IP allow-listing, please send the CIDR blocks today.

Kimberly
Senior Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: none

From: Emma White <emma.white@fjordbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: runtime evidence portal access & credentialing

Thanks all — username + one-time password is fine for our auditor. CIDR for the auditor's laptop is 198.51.100.24/32 (they can also use a VPN if you prefer).

We don't require a separate NDA for the portal; our engagement is covered under the existing SCA and the redwood-fjordbank mutual access agreement signed in July. Please post the ephemeral credentials to the Drive link and notify me when the account is live so we can schedule the 30-minute validation session.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Emma
